interval_method: Conservative 95% exact-binomial rectangle interval: q=P(discordance), theta=P(left-only | discordance); separate 97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals, transform rectangle extrema q*(2*theta-1). Union bound gives at least 95% joint coverage, including zero discordances.
multiplicity: Holm step-down familywise alpha 0.05 across the three secondary escape tests, regardless of primary outcome. No claim of one combined family across primary and secondary questions.

bootstrap.finite_denominators: Drop zero-denominator resamples per metric and report retained count.
